# Reference traces (the reference engine)

Engine: the reference engine (Brood War 1.16.1 rules), Fastest speed (42 ms a frame). Map: (2)Bottleneck.scm (read as Brood War).
Random seed: 42 (the reference engine's value at map load; each fight and test starts from a fresh map load). Same placement as the combat numbers: side A centre (3680, 2384), side B centre (3936, 2384); each side's units are created at its centre and given Attack Move to the other centre.
Positions are map pixels; times are game frames at Fastest.
